industries.name: Construction, Engineering & Architecture
industries.headline: Spend less time chasing documents and more time delivering projects.
industries.lead: For contractors, engineering consultancies and architecture practices. We organise technical knowledge, streamline document-heavy workflows and support project reporting, with your specialists in charge of every technical decision.
pains: Plans, specifications and correspondence change often and need careful version control
Project decisions and technical details are spread across documents and tools
Routine reporting and coordination pull time away from delivery
Tender and proposal preparation repeats the same research every time
Knowledge leaves with people when projects end

faqs.q: Can AI interpret project documents?
faqs.a: Document workflows can classify and extract information, with human verification for anything important.

faqs.q: Does this replace technical review?
faqs.a: No. Engineers, architects and project leads stay responsible for technical judgement and approvals.

faqs.q: Can teams search past project knowledge?
faqs.a: Yes. A knowledge assistant retrieves approved material while respecting source permissions.

industries.name: Telecom & Infrastructure
industries.headline: Keep service operations, technical knowledge and customer support in step.
industries.lead: For telecom operators, tower and fibre companies, and infrastructure service providers. We streamline support, documentation and reporting across the systems you already run.
pains: Routine service requests compete with complex cases for support time
Technical procedures are hard to find across teams and sites
Data from different platforms makes service performance hard to read
Site, permit and contractor documents need consistent processing
Competitor and market moves are tracked by hand

faqs.q: Can AI resolve service requests?
faqs.a: It can handle approved routine requests and route technical or sensitive cases to your staff.

faqs.q: Can field teams search technical guidance?
faqs.a: Yes. A knowledge assistant can surface approved procedures with suitable access controls.

faqs.q: How do you approach security?
faqs.a: We review each proposed AI workflow and its data handling, then agree safeguards with your security team.

industries.name: Media & Entertainment

industries.name: Legal Services
industries.headline: Handle documents and knowledge faster, with confidentiality built in.

pains: Large sets of contracts and correspondence need structured review
Precedents and practice guidance are hard to find consistently
Confidentiality and professional duties require clear AI boundaries
Client intake and matter updates involve repetitive admin
Business development relies on ad hoc research

faqs.q: Can AI provide legal advice?
faqs.a: No. AI can support internal workflows; qualified lawyers remain responsible for advice and review.

faqs.q: Can confidential documents be used?
faqs.a: We assess tools, permissions and data flows and recommend safeguards for your internal review first.

faqs.q: Can you draft an AI policy for a firm?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare an AI policy and use register for review against your professional obligations.

industries.name: Nonprofits & Social Enterprises

pains: Routine coordination and reporting compete with programme delivery

faqs.q: How do we protect community information?

industries.name: Government & Public Sector
industries.headline: Modernise public services with transparency and human oversight.
industries.lead: For public bodies, agencies and organisations that deliver public services. We support internal knowledge, records processing and responsible AI adoption designed for accountability.
pains: Policies and service guidance are spread across departments and systems
Forms and correspondence need repeated classification and data entry
AI use needs clear governance, accountability and safeguards
Citizen enquiries arrive through many channels
Reporting to leadership takes days of manual work

faqs.q: Can AI make public service decisions?
faqs.a: Our focus is decision support and administrative assistance; accountable staff keep authority.

faqs.q: How is public information kept accurate?
faqs.a: Solutions use approved sources, named owners and escalation when information is unclear.

faqs.q: Is your readiness work a formal audit?

pains: Specifications and supplier documents need accurate handling
